# Python example with a linked list
class Node:
    def __init__(self, value):
        self.value = value
        self.next = None

class LinkedList:
    def __init__(self):
        self.head = None

    def peek(self):
        if self.head:
            return self.head.value
        return None

ll = LinkedList()
ll.head = Node(1)
ll.head.next = Node(2)
ll.head.next.next = Node(3)

print(ll.peek())  # Outputs: 1
